summary_zh: 本页为绘本《弗洛格去旅行》的封面，展示了青蛙弗洛格和老鼠朋友背着行囊、手持拐杖在森林小径上旅行的画面，主题为学会接触外面的世界。

page_text_ocr_zh: 老鼠站在山丘上，注视着地平线。“这个世界真是美丽！”他赞叹着，突然觉得自己该动身旅行了。
page_text_en: The mouse stood on a hill, gazing at the horizon. "This world is truly beautiful!" he exclaimed, suddenly feeling he should set off on a journey.
summary_zh: 老鼠站在山丘上眺望远方，被美丽的景色打动，决定开始旅行。

page_text_ocr_zh: 第二天一大早，老鼠收拾行李，往背包里装满了旅途所需要的用品和粮食，急着去探险。
page_text_en: Early the next morning, the mouse packed his luggage, filled his backpack with all the supplies and food needed for the journey, and was eager to go on an adventure.
summary_zh: 老鼠在家中收拾行李，将旅途所需的用品和粮食装进背包，准备出发探险。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他还没走远，就听到有人在叫：“等等我啊！”他看看四周，才发现青蛙弗洛格正朝他跑来。“老鼠！”弗洛格问，“你要去哪里？”“去外面的世界探险！”老鼠说。
page_text_en: He hadn't gone far when he heard someone calling: "Wait for me!" He looked around and saw that Frog Floppy was running toward him. "Mouse!" Floppy asked, "Where are you going?" "To explore the world outside!" the mouse said.
summary_zh: 弗洛格在老鼠出发后不久追上他，询问他要去哪里，老鼠回答要去外面的世界探险。

page_text_ocr_zh: “我可以和你一起去吗？”弗洛格很兴奋。“绝对不行！”老鼠叫道，“你太小了，不适合这种旅行。”“哦，老鼠，拜托！我个子虽小，但是我很强壮，可以帮忙扛东西。我们两个去比你一个人去更好玩嘛！”“好吧，那来吧！不过不许落在后面。”老鼠说。
page_text_en: "Can I go with you?" Frog said excitedly. "Absolutely not!" the mouse shouted, "You're too small for this kind of trip." "Oh, mouse, please! I may be small, but I'm strong and can help carry things. It'll be more fun for both of us than for you alone!" "Alright, then come on! But don't fall behind," the mouse said.
summary_zh: 弗洛格请求和老鼠一起去旅行，老鼠起初拒绝，但最终同意，条件是弗洛格不能落在后面。

page_text_ocr_zh: 于是两个好朋友走向了外面的世界。弗洛格背着登山包，老鼠带路。“这里真漂亮！”过了一会儿弗洛格说，“跟家乡不一样呢！”他从来没有离开家这么远过。
page_text_en: So the two good friends set off into the outside world. Frog was carrying a hiking backpack, and the mouse was leading the way. “This place is really beautiful!” Frog said after a while. “It’s different from home!” He had never been so far away from home before.
summary_zh: 弗洛格和老鼠一起踏上旅途，弗洛格背着登山包，对新环境感到新奇，感叹这里与家乡不同，也意识到自己从未离开家这么远。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他们走了一段路后，弗洛格坐了下来。“我饿了，我们什么时候可以吃午餐？”他问。“什么？”老鼠大叫道，“我们才开始走呢！”说完，他还是从背包里拿出两个花生酱三明治。“听好！这只是点心。”他严厉地说，“我们还有很长的路要走。”
page_text_en: After walking for a while, Frog sat down. "I'm hungry. When can we have lunch?" he asked. "What?" the mouse shouted. "We've just started walking!" After saying that, he still took out two peanut butter sandwiches from his backpack. "Listen! This is just a snack," he said sternly. "We still have a long way to go."
summary_zh: 弗洛格和老鼠在旅途中休息，弗洛格饿了想吃午餐，老鼠拿出花生酱三明治并强调这只是点心，提醒他们还有很长的路要走。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他们吃完三明治，立刻出发。“快到了吗？”弗洛格问道。“到哪里？”老鼠问。“外面的世界呀！”弗洛格说。“怎么会？”老鼠不耐烦地说，“我们才刚刚离开家没几步呢！”
page_text_en: They finished their sandwiches and set off immediately. "Are we nearly there?" asked Frog. "Where to?" asked the mouse. "The world outside!" said Frog. "How can that be?" said the mouse impatiently. "We've only just left home a few steps!"
summary_zh: 弗洛格和老鼠吃完三明治后继续旅行，弗洛格兴奋地认为他们快到达外面的世界，但老鼠不耐烦地指出他们才刚离开家不远。

page_text_ocr_zh:
当他们停下来的时候，太阳已经快下山了。
“我好累，不能再走了！”弗洛格呻吟着，“我们什么时候可以回家呢？”
“家？”老鼠大吃一惊，“没这回事！这里是我们过夜的地方。”
page_text_en:
When they stopped, the sun was already close to setting.
"I'm so tired, I can't walk anymore!" Floppy groaned, "When can we go home?"
"Home?" the mouse was startled. "No way! This is where we're spending the night."
summary_zh: 弗洛格和老鼠在旅途中停下休息，弗洛格因疲惫想回家，老鼠却告诉他这里就是他们过夜的地方。

page_text_ocr_zh: 老鼠找到一块舒服的地方。他们都躺下来休息。“老鼠！”弗洛格过了一会儿说，“我睡不着。”“闭上眼睛，想着你最喜欢的东西。”老鼠说。弗洛格努力试了，可是没用。他听到了奇怪的声音，是狮子，还是老虎？
page_text_en: The mouse found a comfortable spot. They both lay down to rest. "Mouse!" Frog said after a while, "I can't sleep." "Close your eyes and think of your favorite thing," the mouse said. Frog tried hard, but it didn't work. He heard strange sounds—was it a lion, or a tiger?
summary_zh: 弗洛格和老鼠在旅途中找到一处地方休息，弗洛格因睡不着而感到害怕，他听到了奇怪的声音，怀疑是狮子或老虎。

page_text_ocr_zh: 天亮了，弗洛格还不起床。在老鼠的一再坚持下，他们继续旅行。爬过一个又一个的山丘，他们走向了外面的世界。“我们快到了吗？”弗洛格喘着气。“还差得远呢！”老鼠说，“如果你想见识广大的世界，就要有毅力。”
page_text_en: It was morning, but Frog couldn't get out of bed. With the mouse's persistent urging, they continued their journey. Climbing over hill after hill, they headed toward the outside world. "Are we almost there?" Frog panted. "We're still far away!" the mouse said, "If you want to see the vast world, you need perseverance."
summary_zh: 天亮后弗洛格不愿起床，但在老鼠的坚持下继续旅行，他们翻过多个山丘，弗洛格询问是否快到目的地，老鼠提醒他还有很长的路，并强调见识世界需要毅力。

page_text_ocr_zh: 突然，天空变暗了。太阳躲进云里，接着下起了雨。刚开始只是小雨，后来越下越大。两个朋友赶紧找地方躲雨。
page_text_en: Suddenly, the sky turned dark. The sun hid behind the clouds, and then it started to rain. At first, it was only a light rain, but then it grew heavier and heavier. The two friends hurried to find a place to take shelter from the rain.
summary_zh: 弗洛格和老鼠在旅途中突然遇到下雨，天空变暗，雨越下越大，他们赶紧寻找地方躲雨。

他们虽然没淋到什么雨，但是弗洛格感到
很冷。“我在想家里怎么样了。”他用企盼的口
吻说，“小猪怎么样了？还有小鸭、野兔？”老鼠
说：“雨停了，走吧！”
page_text_en:
They hadn't gotten wet from much rain, but Frog felt
very cold. "I'm thinking about how things are at home," he said with an eager tone, "How is Pig? And Duck, and Rabbit?" Mouse
said, "The rain has stopped, let's go!"
summary_zh: 弗洛格和老鼠在雨中躲藏，弗洛格因寒冷而思念家中的朋友，老鼠催促他雨停后继续出发。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他们走着走着，爬过岩堆和石头，走到没有人居住的荒山上。“你看这里，是不是很美呢？”老鼠问弗洛格。弗洛格早就累得倒下来了，根本什么也看不到。
page_text_en: They walked and walked, climbing over rock piles and stones, until they reached a deserted mountain. "Look here, isn't it beautiful?" the mouse asked Frog. Frog had already collapsed from exhaustion and could see nothing at all.
summary_zh: 弗洛格和老鼠继续旅行，来到一座荒山，老鼠称赞景色美丽，但弗洛格因疲惫而倒下，什么也看不见。

page_text_ocr_zh: “我想我的脚断了！好疼呀，我不能走了。”弗洛格哭丧着脸，艰难地走着。“这样我们哪儿也去不成！”老鼠埋怨着，“从现在起，我来背你。”
page_text_en: "I think my leg is broken! It hurts so much, I can't walk anymore." Frog cried, walking with difficulty. "This way, we can't go anywhere!" complained the mouse. "From now on, I'll carry you."
summary_zh: 弗洛格因脚疼无法继续行走，老鼠无奈之下决定背他前行。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他把弗洛格背在背上，继续向前走着。“小猪说不定正在烤蛋糕。”弗洛格说，“不知道小鸭和野兔在做什么。在家的时候我们总是那么快乐。”
page_text_en: He carried Frog on his back and continued walking forward. "Pig might be baking a cake," Frog said, "I don't know what Duck and Rabbit are doing. At home, we are always so happy."
summary_zh: 老鼠背着弗洛格继续前行，弗洛格回忆起在家时与小猪、小鸭和野兔的快乐时光。

page_text_ocr_zh: “你还有整个下半辈子可以待在家。”老鼠说，“但是，现在我们正走在通往神秘之地的路上。看看你的四周，多么美丽啊！每一个地方都是我们没有见过的。”
page_text_en: "You still have the whole rest of your life to stay at home," said the mouse. "But now, we are walking on the path to the mysterious land. Look around you, how beautiful it is! Every place is something we have never seen before."
summary_zh: 老鼠背着疲惫的弗洛格继续前行，他鼓励弗洛格欣赏沿途的美景，强调他们正在通往神秘之地的路上，所见皆是新奇的风景。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他们走到一片草地上，老鼠把弗洛格放下来。“我累坏了！我们得睡在这儿了。”他说。“这儿？”弗洛格慌了，“在家里，我有一张全世界最棒的小床……”他说着说着就睡着了。
page_text_en: They walked to a grassy field, and the mouse put Frog down. "I'm exhausted! We have to sleep here," he said. "Here?" Frog panicked. "At home, I have the best little bed in the whole world..." He said that and fell asleep.
summary_zh: 弗洛格和老鼠走到一片草地上休息，老鼠放下弗洛格，弗洛格因疲惫而抱怨，但很快在回忆家中的小床时睡着了。

page_text_ocr_zh: 第二天清早醒来，弗洛格坐在草堆上，哭丧着一张脸。“老鼠，我不舒服！我觉得自己病得很重。我不想去见识广大的世界了。我好想家！”老鼠说：“你不是真的生病，只是患了思乡病。”
page_text_en: The next morning, Frog sat on a pile of grass, looking sad and crying. "Mouse, I don't feel well! I think I'm very sick. I don't want to go see the big wide world anymore. I miss home so much!" Mouse said, "You're not really sick, you just have homesickness."
summary_zh: 弗洛格因旅途疲惫和思乡而感到不适，坐在草堆上哭泣，老鼠安慰他说他只是患了思乡病。

page_text_ocr_zh: “思乡病？”弗洛格惊跳起来问，“这病严重吗？”“不会！”老鼠说，“你一回家就会好的。”“家……”弗洛格像做梦般地自言自语。“没错，”老鼠说，“我们回家吧！”
page_text_en: "Homesickness?" Frog jumped up in surprise and asked, "Is this illness serious?" "No!" said the mouse, "You'll be fine as soon as you go home." "Home..." Frog murmured to himself, as if in a dream. "Right," said the mouse, "Let's go home!"
summary_zh: 弗洛格因思乡而情绪低落，老鼠安慰他并决定带他回家。

page_text_ocr_zh: 弗洛格不再需要人背了。他跑在前头，只想早点回到小猪、小鸭和野兔的身边。老鼠笑了。“你不介意回家去吗？”弗洛格问。“不会，不会！”老鼠说，“我也有点儿想家，这很正常。”
page_text_en: Frog no longer needed to be carried. He ran ahead, wanting to get back to Pig, Duck, and Rabbit as soon as possible. The mouse smiled. “Don’t you mind going home?” Frog asked. “No, no!” the mouse said, “I’m a bit homesick too. That’s perfectly normal.”
summary_zh: 弗洛格恢复体力后跑在前面，想早点回家，老鼠笑着回应他也有点想家，认为这是正常现象。

page_text_en: After walking for several hours, Frog shouted, "Look! We're almost home!" Indeed, in the distance, they could see Pig, Duck, and Rabbit waiting for them. Frog ran towards his friends, as if wings had grown on his body.
summary_zh: 弗洛格和老鼠在长途跋涉后终于快到家了，弗洛格兴奋地看到朋友们在远处等待，他像长了翅膀一样飞奔过去。

We had so many exciting adventures—lions, tigers, and more..." "First, let's go inside and eat cake, then tell us all about it," said the pig. That was exactly what Frog wanted to hear.

"But there is no place that can compare to home!" Frog happily thought of his cozy and warm little bed.
summary_zh: 弗洛格和朋友们围坐在餐桌旁，一边享用小猪做的蛋糕，一边听弗洛格讲述旅途中的冒险故事，他心中想着家的温暖。

page_text_ocr_zh:
学会接触外面的世界
外面的世界有好多好多有趣的事，让我们出去见识一下吧！
你会学到很多知识，会感到很快乐——不过，有时候也会很辛苦，
这时候你就要有毅力才行。

想一想
1. 老鼠一开始为什么不愿意带着青蛙去外面的世界探险？
2. 老鼠在旅途中看到了什么美丽的景色？青蛙觉得这景色美丽吗？
3. 最后老鼠和青蛙到了哪里？

试一试
请爸爸妈妈有机会就带你一起出去旅行吧！请你说一说：最近一次出去旅行时都看到了一些什么新鲜事？
page_text_en:
Learning to Explore the Outside World
The outside world has so many interesting things. Let's go out and see for ourselves!
You'll learn a lot, and feel happy — but sometimes it can be hard.
That's when you need to be strong and determined.

Think About It
1. Why was the mouse reluctant to take the frog on an adventure at first?
2. What beautiful scenery did the mouse see on the journey? Did the frog think it was beautiful?
3. Where did the mouse and the frog finally arrive?

Try This
Ask your parents to take you on a trip sometime! Tell us: What new things did you see during your last trip?

这是一套有助于孩子心灵成长的心理教育故事。每个故事都自然流露出某种重要的主题，充满了想象力。文图都是马克斯·维尔修思创作的，文字透着生动和浅浅的幽默，图画则是鲜有的简笔画风格，被西方艺术家誉为“简笔画世界的杰作”。目前该系列已经被翻译成38种语言，全球销量逾百万册。

Author Max Velthuijs is a highly acclaimed children's illustrator internationally.
This series has won the Dutch Golden Pencil Award, the French Prix de Treize Award, the German Bestlist Award, and the American Graphic Award.

"Each illustration is a beautiful and simple way of communication; the entire sequence of images is a small, exquisite work of art."
— UK, 'Times Educational Supplement'

"Every child should have the chance to meet Froggy."
— UK, 'Library Journal'

This is a series of psychological education stories that support children's emotional growth. Each story naturally reveals an important theme and is full of imagination. Both text and illustrations are created by Max Velthuijs. The text is lively and subtly humorous, while the illustrations feature a rare simple-line style, hailed by Western artists as 'a masterpiece of simple-line art'. The series has been translated into 38 languages and has sold over a million copies worldwide.
